plan.notes: Official ASU major map (Liberal Studies, BA, plan LABLSBLS, campus ASU00). Term-by-term sequence as published. Credit ranges transcribed at the lower bound per convention; 'X or Y' alternatives use the first-listed option as the course code with choice=true. Gen-ed placeholders (no course code on the map) transcribed verbatim as choice slots. The official major map lists the following course(s) in more than one term: Complete 3 courses: Elective, ENG 101 or ENG 102: First-Year Composition OR ENG 105: Advanced First-Year Composition OR ENG 107 or ENG 108: First-Year Composition, Elective, Scientific Thinking in Natural Sciences (SCIT), Term hours subtotal:, Upper Division Humanities, Arts and Design (HUAD), Upper Division Social and Behavioral Sciences (SOBE) OR Global Communities, Societies and Individuals (GCSI) OR Sustainability (SUST) OR American Institutions (AMIT) OR Governance and Civic Engagement (CIVI); allow_repeated_courses is set per the genuine-repeat rule. CORRECTION 2026-10-06 (wave-33 coordinator): removed the 'Term hours subtotal:' metadata rows the wave-32 harvester had transcribed as pseudo-courses in every term; per-term declared_credits and plan total_credits recomputed as the true sum of the official map's listed courses. All other fields (codes, titles, credits, order, choice flags, repeats) unchanged from the official ASU major map transcription.
